title: Surf Session Abort Rate After Red-Flag Forecasts
dataSources: Rides (`ride:session`), charge sessions (`ride:charge`), ride exports (`ride:export`), surf forecasts (`surf:forecast`), ride incidents (`ride:incident`), segment efforts (`fitness:segment`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sports telemetry — Onewheel ride exports, legacy Boosted board logs, Surfline forecast snapshots, and Strava segment efforts — streamed to Splunk HEC via vendor exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=surf:forecast spot=* red_flag=* session_aborted=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(session_aborted="yes",1,0))) as matched by spot
| eval an_aborted_session_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - an_aborted_session_pct
description: Measures the percentage of forecasted surf sessions that end with an aborted session by surf spot.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which surf spot are helping or hurting forecasted surf sessions.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `an aborted session` on `surf:forecast` events and summarize the hit rate by `spot`.
visualization: Table of surf spot with percentage of forecasted surf sessions ending with an aborted session.
grandmaExplanation: It builds how often an aborted session happens for each surf spot so you can see where forecasted surf sessions go smoothly or get stuck.
